title: 4 High Short Interest Stocks to Buy Before October
creator: MarketBeat (analyst Chris Marcott)
summary: MarketBeat analyst Chris Marcott opens by teaching the basics of short interest (share of float sold short; above 10% is high) and days to cover, explaining that high interest plus high days-to-cover creates short-squeeze conditions (cites GameStop 2021). He then walks through four popular high-short-interest names with a 50/50 split. HIMS: down 45% in 12 months at ~$29 with 26.7% short interest; revenue +40% YoY with strong international growth but margins and free cash flow under pressure and an unresolved GLP-1 lawsuit overhang -- AVOID, shorts may be right, consensus target only ~$32. ONDS (Ondas Holdings; auto-captions garble the name as 'Andis' but recap sources confirm): >40% short interest, 3.7 days to cover, 35% institutional ownership; autonomous systems/robotics story with growing revenue but widening losses -- AVOID for now; must show a credible path to profitability at the November Q3 report before he'd touch it. COIN: 12% short interest (down 19% in a month), up 32% in three months; Bitcoin/Ethereum catching a bid and the Clarity Act now has a path to passage -- BUY, shorts are wrong on this one. SOFI: ~14% short interest, down 36% YTD; profitable on GAAP and non-GAAP, but the market treats it as 'just a bank' at 34x earnings; he holds, long-term bullish, admits he's been early for a year. Also promotes a free 'buy and hold forever' dividend report.

calls.thesis: Revenue +40% YoY with international expansion, but margin/FCF pressure plus unresolved GLP-1 lawsuit overhang; wait-and-see, shorts not wrong.
calls.base_case: Base: growth intact, legal overhang caps upside near PT $32.
calls.bull_case: Lawsuit resolved + targets raised -> 26.7% short interest fuels a squeeze.
calls.bear_case: Legal overhang persists; ~$65 2025 high a long way off.
